greeting.text: I'm Milena Vukovic, the retired railway worker. I used to keep the railway running. These days I watch the streets and help newcomers find their way.

choices.text: [Courier] I am here to collect the parcel.
[Persuade] Please, I need your advice to stay safe.
[Find item] Tell me about your request.
[Find item] I found the requested item.

advice.text: Walking between districts is free. The bus costs Thalers and does not run at night.

about.text: I used to keep the railway running. These days I watch the streets and help newcomers find their way. Morning: you can find me in the streets of Living District. Afternoon: you can find me in the streets of Center. Evening: you can find me in the streets of Living District. Night: you can find me in apartment 11 in Living District.

courier-pickup-confirmed.text: Take this parcel to the recipient named in your journal.

courier-delivery-thanks.text: Thank you. Here is your payment.

find-item-instructions.text: Find the requested item and take it to the recipient in your journal.

find-item-payment.text: Exactly what was requested. Here is your payment.

lost-suitcase.text: I lost my suitcase near the bus stop in Living District, and I cannot find it anywhere. There is a photograph of my family inside. It is very dear to me. You can keep everything else in the suitcase, but please bring me that photo. I have an Athletics magazine for you if you find it.

choices.text: I'll look for your suitcase and bring back the photo.

photo-accepted.text: Thank you. Please bring the family photo back to me. The rest is yours.

photo-thanks.text: My family! I thought I had lost this photo forever. Thank you for bringing it back. Here is the Athletics magazine I promised you.
